column2: Why does the transcription made in the Workshop show everywhere?
column3: A document has only one text: the one in the 📜 Transcription workshop. The viewer’s “Document transcription” box shows and changes that same text, and it also shows on the document page (with its kind, its status and “📜 Open in the Workshop”), on the record of the linked people (block “📜 Records and transcriptions”), in search (the top search too), the lists, the GEDCOM export (box “Document transcriptions”) and the book (“With the transcription” when placing an image). Several records on one image: one block per record, each edited in the Workshop. Nothing is overwritten: a text already written for the document is kept below the new one. On a record, a name found but not linked yet shows “to be linked”, with “Link” (and ↶ Undo).

column2: How do I arrange the tabs of an estate case?
column3: At first, a single row of tabs: what does not fit in the width goes into “More ▾” (with its counters), and the open tab always stays visible; on a phone the row also scrolls. In the case, ⋯ → “🗂 Tab layout…” (or Settings → Case tools → “🗂 Tabs of a case”) also offers “By families” (📁 File, 🔎 Research, 📑 Documents, ✉️ Contacts, 🕓 Follow-up, then their tabs) or “A column on the left” (a single-choice menu on a small screen). The counters stay visible (Documents 1 / 2, Contacted 2 / 6). At the bottom of 📁 File, a clickable summary shows where the case stands: heirs, documents, contacted, next deadline.
